notes: Accessed entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab (no HTTP/proxy route). robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai agent and has Allow: / for User-agent: * with /collections/ crawlable, so extraction is permitted. TREE: taken from the site's own rendered mega-menu on the homepage. The MOBILIER department has exactly three column groups - Tables (Tables a manger, Tables basses & d'appoint), Assises (Canapes, Fauteuils & repose-pieds, Chaises, Poufs & bancs) and Meubles de rangement (Bibliotheques, Buffets/armoires & commodes, Bureaux & secretaires, Etageres) - plus a 'Voir tout' link dropped per brief S3. The three column headers are emitted as grouping rows; the 10 children are the deepest nodes (no further level exists, confirmed by the breadcrumb 'Accueil > MOBILIER > <group> > <leaf>' on each leaf page). QTY METHOD: this Shopify theme publishes NO 'N produits' results header anywhere on a collection page (searched rendered text and raw HTML for produit/resultat/article - only layout-switch aria-labels matched). The site does render its own per-collection counts in the server-rendered 'Type de produit' filter facet block, and those facet counts sum to the collection total. Every leaf qty was taken from that rendered facet sum AND independently confirmed by an exhaustive same-origin fetch() of /collections/<handle>/products.json with limit=250 paged to exhaustion and product IDs deduped (the method the prior Home-Decor pass validated on this store; Shopify's inflated collections.json products_count was NOT used). All 10 leaves matched exactly between the two methods. Sanity checks: each page's h1 matched the intended category (Tables a manger / Tables basses & D'appoint / Canapes / Fauteuils & Repose-pieds / Chaises / Poufs & Bancs / Bibliotheques / Buffets, armoires & commodes / Bureaux & Secretaires / Etageres); the numbers all differ from each other and from the parent totals (parent Tables=144, Assises=148, Meubles de rangement=110, MOBILIER=390), so no site-wide constant is being echoed; none is a suspicious round number; canapes was additionally cross-checked against the page's own 'Livraison rapide (94)' filter count. COVERAGE CHECK: the union of the 10 leaf collections covers 380 of the 390 products in the parent /collections/mobilier; the 10 leftovers are 6 tables, 1 bed, 1 poster and 1 puzzle - so there is no hidden furniture sub-branch, and no Beds category exists (a single bed product site-wide). PRODUCT-TYPE AUDIT: every leaf is dominated by genuine furniture product_types. Notable checks - 'Set de table' inside Tables basses & d'appoint means SETS OF TABLES (nesting/gigogne table sets), not placemats; the 12 'Petit rangement' items in Buffets, armoires & commodes are real cabinets, lowboards and chests of drawers (Facet cabinets, Space dressers). EXCLUDED DEPARTMENTS: DECORATION, TABLE & CUISINE, LUMINAIRE, LIFESTYLE, IDEES CADEAUX, BRADERIE, NEW, MUST HAVE, CARTES CADEAUX (no furniture). KIDS > 'Mobilier & decoration enfant' (/collections/mobilier-decoration-enfant, 73 items) was opened and audited despite its name: product_types are 32 Objet mural decoratif, 19 Decoration murale, 15 Veilleuse, 5 Lampe / Lampe de table, 2 Objet decoratif - ZERO furniture - so it is wall decor plus lighting; its two menu children (Decorations enfant, Mobiles & veilleuses enfant) are likewise decor/lighting and belong to earlier passes. GREEN > Mobilier (/collections/mobilier-green) is a sustainability facet re-cut of the same MOBILIER catalogue, not a distinct branch - dropped. OUTDOOR CHECK: the sitemap collections list (717 handles) was scanned for furniture and outdoor slugs. /collections/tables-d-exterieur and /collections/chaises-fauteuils-enfant are EMPTY (0 products); /collections/mobilier-outdoor has 9 items of which 7 are electric table-fire pits and only 2 armchairs; /collections/outdoor (12) and /collections/jardin (31) are planters, pots and garden tools; /collections/accessoires-outdoor (14) is fire pits and garden tools. None of these appear in the site navigation and none is a genuine outdoor-furniture listing, so no Outdoor Furniture rows were emitted. Skipped as non-nav legacy/subset duplicates of nodes already recorded: /collections/armoires-commodes (30) and /collections/buffets (26) are subsets of buffets-armoires-commodes (31); /collections/letagere-superieure (24) is a subset of etageres; /collections/chaises-transats (7) is a subset of chaises. Brand pages (ethnicraft, hay, hk-living...), gift-price-tier pages and 'Voir tout' links excluded per brief S3.
